data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'laurus', meaning 'laurel'. The name Laurent was given to honor the god Apollo, who was often depicted wearing a crown of laurel leaves. In Christianity, St. Lawrence is the patron saint of cooks, students, and deacons. The name Laurent carries the meaning “From the laurel tree” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Laurent usually hope their child will grow to embody from the laurel tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם לורנט נגזר מהמילה העברית 'דפנה' (דפנא), שפירושה עץ הדפנה, ומשויך לכבוד והוד. בדפנה היא גם דמות במיתולוגיה היוונית, אך השם לורנט עצמו הושפע מהשפה הלטינית.

in_greek.name: Λοράντ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λοράντ προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'laurus', που σημαίνει δάφνη, ένα σύμβολο τιμής και δόξας. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, η δάφνη συνδέεται με τον Απόλλωνα και συμβολίζει τη νίκη και την αριστεία.

in_latin.name: Laurent
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Laurent is derived from the Latin word 'laurus', meaning laurel tree, a symbol of honor and glory in ancient Roman culture. The laurel wreath was awarded to victors and heroes, signifying achievement and prestige.

in_english.name: Laurent
in_english.long_meaning: The name Laurent originates from the Latin 'laurus', meaning laurel tree, which symbolizes honor, glory, and achievement. In Christian tradition, the laurel tree represents victory over adversity and is associated with martyrdom and sainthood. Historically, the name Laurent has been used in various Christian cultures, signifying strength, courage, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laurent is of Latin origin and brings with it a rich cultural history. It is reminiscent of ancient Rome and the Roman god Apollo, who was recognized for his power in Prophecy, Music, and Poetry. This name has been passed down through generations and is still popular today.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Laurent is associated with St. Lawrence, a deacon and martyr who is celebrated for his heroic faith. He is said to have distributed the church's treasury to the poor, and then, when ordered to hand it over to the emperor, he presented the poor instead. His faith and charitable giving are celebrated in the name and are a powerful reminder of the importance of generosity, faith, and service to others.
